name: Content Review material usefulness policy

material_identity.verified_paper_and_related_presentation: Keep the paper as the primary research resource, with slides or recording as separately typed supporting assets.

presentation_without_substantive_audio.numeric_deduction: Not yet calibrated; do not invent a numeric score or report this policy as applied by the live scorer.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.user_basis: A deck or presentation without audio is of very limited standalone value to ALEX.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.slides_without_speaker_notes: Record the additional context limitation. Slides and missing notes are not a full research paper.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.notes_alone: Do not waive the audio-related deduction merely because slides or speaker notes exist.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.audio_status_unknown: Hold media verification and mark the deduction provisional; do not claim audio is absent before checking.
presentation_without_substantive_audio.verified_audio_absent: Apply the major resource-usefulness deduction and retain its reason in assessment output.

verification: full or substantively complete presentation rather than teaser or excerpt
working canonical link and access conditions
verified_substantive_recording.effect: Remove the missing-audio deduction only after verification; assess usefulness and quality normally.
verified_substantive_recording.paper_status: Remain typed as a presentation or recording; no inferred paper status or peer review.

evidence_to_record: paper_url and verified format when present
implementation_note: This file records the user's scoring instruction. The scorer and background worker must consume the rule before claiming a numeric deduction has been applied.
